name: Macroeconomics AP: Fiscavo
subtitle: Macroeconomics AP practice
shortDescription: Study AP Macroeconomics your way: adaptive practice, interactive graphs and labs, timed mocks and free-response practice. No account. Works offline.
longDescription:
Prepare for the AP Macroeconomics exam with practice that adapts to you, graphs you can drag, and mock exams that follow the real layout. No account. No internet needed.

TWO WAYS TO STUDY, ONE PROGRESS RECORD. Follow the course in syllabus order, or switch to Real-World view and work through missions built from everyday economic problems. Switch at any time: your progress, your weak spots and your study plan stay the same in both.

PRACTICE THAT ADAPTS. Quizzes and tests feed a personal progress map. When an answer shows a gap, the app links you to the exact lesson and the next questions that close it, and brings topics back for review just before you would forget them. Pin topics, set a focus and save your own plan.

THE WHOLE COURSE. All six units of the course, with short lessons, graph-labelling reminders and formula lists. A Coverage screen shows exactly which course topics have lessons and how many questions each topic has.

LABS YOU CAN SHIFT. Move a curve and watch the equilibrium respond in the aggregate demand and supply model, the money market, loanable funds and the foreign exchange market, and work through multipliers, policy and the numbers behind CPI, unemployment and growth. Then answer a question built from your own numbers.

MOCK EXAMS AND FREE RESPONSE. Timed multiple-choice mocks and free-response sets with line-by-line rubrics for you to score yourself. The estimated score is a rough guide only.

OTHER BOARDS. An optional map links each topic to related material in A Level, IB and GCSE economics, so you can prepare extra material if you move between systems.

SOURCES YOU CAN CHECK. Topics point to the College Board course and exam description and to matching chapters of the OpenStax macroeconomics textbook, which is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and is linked, never copied.

BUILT TO READ COMFORTABLY. Text size from 50% to 300%, a bright clear design, and layouts that use the whole screen on iPhone and iPad.

Practice questions are our own writing and have not been reviewed by a teacher or subject expert. No real exam questions are included. Estimated scores are not predictions of exam results.
